name: board
title: Board
description: Kanban lanes — full-height lanes that scroll their cards inside, sticky headers with a collapse menu, + Add at each lane's foot, Nothing here / Drop here empty zones, per-lane skeletons and load-on-scroll paging; live pointer and touch drag (lift, make room, settle, edge auto-scroll), a keyboard pick-up/move/drop model, a lossless per-card Move menu, optimistic moves with rollback and a toast, and one lane at a time on a phone.

meta.whenToUse: Cross-column card movement — pipelines, kanban, staged workflows — where the host owns ordering and the move can be refused by a server gate; lanes may be partially loaded (count shows the total) and cards may be links to their records.
meta.whenNotToUse: Single-list reordering (sortable-list), tabular data (data-list/data-grid), or static column layouts with no movement (plain Cards in a flex row).
